paragraph_requires: All share and per-share amounts presented in these consolidated financial statements have been retroactively adjusted
Reflects the one-for-seven reverse share split that became effective on March 15, 2024
outstanding warrants, share option plans and convertible notes
(in thousands, except share and per share data)
decisions.reader_note: For Lifeward’s 2023–2025 figures in its 2025 annual filing, the ordinary-share counts and per-share amounts already reflect the March 2024 one-for-seven and February 2026 one-for-twelve reverse splits. No additional adjustment is applied. Warrants, share options and convertible notes are excluded from diluted loss per share as anti-dilutive. The selected USD-per-share EPS and full scale-zero share counts are preserved. This review is limited to that filing and does not resolve the separate currency conflicts withheld from the older ReWalk filing.

paragraph_requires: using the treasury stock method unless their effect is antidilutive
as of the end of the periods presented because their inclusion would have been antidilutive
(in thousands, except share and per share amounts)
decisions.reader_note: For Weave in 2023–2025, potentially dilutive common shares are excluded as anti-dilutive, and the filing describes the treasury-stock method for potential dilution. Its exclusion table reports outstanding securities at period-end; those counts are not added to the weighted-average denominator. EPS uses net loss rather than comprehensive loss after currency and investment adjustments. Full scale-zero shares and EPS remain unchanged under the share/per-share exception to the thousands heading.
